r19_changes.round: R19-E (pre-release review findings BR-02 and BR-03)
r19_changes.note: The copy is the origin commit above with these changes, made in this repository; the private origin does not have them.

files.CMakeLists.txt: adds the Lua binding test target (with ADVMAT_RTX_BUILD_GMOD_MODULE)
files.README.md: describes the DDS layout check, the refused source spellings and the new tests
files.src/lua_bindings.cpp: BR-02: request strings are refused by length before they are copied (hashes 18 bytes, paths 2048, names 64, others 4096, no NUL); every exported function catches C++ exceptions and returns false and a reason; a failed provider construction registers an unavailable provider
files.src/standalone_module.cpp: BR-02: no C++ exception leaves the module entry point
files.src/texture_ingest.cpp: BR-03: a DDS is checked against its file size (known format, mip count at most 16 and what the dimensions allow, faces and array layers, every described byte present); a cached copy gets the same check from its headers and size. The H3 class (found by R19-X): a texture source spelled as a network, device or drive-relative path (two leading separators, a root name other than a drive letter, a drive letter without a root directory) is refused before any filesystem call, so a caller cannot make Windows open an SMB session. Any source lexically outside every allowed root and outside rtx-remix/mods is refused with one code (texture_path_outside_allowed_roots) before canonical(), whether it exists or not, so the error cannot reveal a file on the player PC
files.tests/writer_tests.cpp: BR-03: valid DDS fixtures, crafted headers refused, a cached copy cut to its header is not reused; UNC, device and drive-relative sources refused from their spelling, local spellings still accepted; a present and a missing file outside the roots give identical results, a game-folder file is still told apart
files.tests/lua_binding_tests.cpp: new, BR-02: the Lua boundary against an in-memory ILuaBase
